title: Non-Conformity
summary: NON-CONFORMITY, noun 1. Neglect or failure of conformity. 2. The neglect or refusal to unite with an established church in its rites and mode of worship.

inlines.v: NON-CONFORMITY, noun 1. Neglect or failure of conformity. 2. The neglect or refusal to unite with an established church in its rites and mode of worship.
